data.narrative:
Ouros Energy is a seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector, having raised $3M+ to date. The broader sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private comp set lacks sufficient granularity for peer-median valuation work—no peers share both Ouros's stage and valuation tier—limiting the triangulation to a single applicable method.

Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $3M raised as a proxy for current value, applies a standard 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to the next financing stage, yielding an $8M valuation. This method is mechanistic and sector-agnostic, offering a floor for expectation-setting but limited insight into company-specific fundamentals or market positioning within the fragmented Climate & Energy landscape.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, with an $8M median. This range reflects purely the mechanics of staged capital progression and carries material uncertainty: the absence of narrow peer comparables means the estimate lacks grounding in comparable company multiples or substantive market evidence. Key unknowns include Ouros's specific technology maturity, capital efficiency relative to sector peers, and the actual timing and stage of the next financing round, all of which would materially inform appropriate valuation placement within or outside this range.
